name: Sanguine
description: A blood weapon that starts as the weakest thing in the game and ends as the strongest: for six phases it can barely hold itself together, and then it stops holding back. Features Bloodletting [Z] and Exsanguinate [X].

phases.name: Phase 1: Droplet
phases.effects: One drop of blood, stretched until it is roughly the shape of an edge. It barely cuts and it barely holds. Base 3 DMG and 12 HP.
phases.notification: That is not a sword. That is a drop of blood doing an impression.

phases.name: Phase 2: Cut
phases.effects: The drop thins into an actual edge. Thin, wet, and disappointing — but it does open things. Base 8 DMG and 30 HP.

phases.name: Phase 3: Bleed
phases.effects: Blood runs continuously off the edge now, leaving a wet red trail through the air behind every swing. Base 22 DMG and 75 HP.
phases.notification: It is leaking. It does not seem to care.

phases.name: Phase 4: Wound
phases.effects: The blade is an open wound that has been convinced to hold a shape: raw, red, and visibly closing and reopening as you move. Base 60 DMG and 190 HP.
phases.notification: It is healing. It is healing wrong.

phases.name: Phase 5: Hemorrhage
phases.effects: Blood sprays clear of the blade in arcs, and the wet trail it leaves behind lingers far too long. Base 150 DMG and 480 HP.
phases.notification: This is not dripping. This is escaping.

phases.name: Phase 6: Bloodloss
phases.effects: The blade is losing more than it can replace: a dark, wet shape with a permanent tremor and a pool forming under the wielder. Base 380 DMG and 1,200 HP.
phases.notification: It is bleeding out. So is everything near it.

phases.name: Phase 7: Flatline
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The blood stops moving and the blade goes still and grey — no pulse, no trail, nothing. Unlocks Bloodletting [Z] — pay 15% of your current HP to deal 400% damage to everything within your swing range and heal for 30% of what it deals. Base 4 DMG and 25 HP.
phases.notification: ...Nothing. No pulse. ...Then what is it still doing in my hand?

phases.name: Phase 8: Rebound
phases.effects: The pulse slams back all at once, and the blade is suddenly heavier and much more alive than the phase before it. Base 1,200 DMG and 4,200 HP.
phases.notification: There it is. That is a heartbeat.

phases.name: Phase 9: Pulse
phases.effects: The whole blade beats in time with the wielder, and every beat throws a ring of blood outward. Base 4,200 DMG and 16,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is keeping time. Your time.

phases.name: Phase 10: Throb
phases.effects: The pulse is irregular and much too strong — the blade swells and contracts, and the ring of blood thrown out with each beat is thick enough to blind. Base 15,000 DMG and 60,000 HP.
phases.notification: That is not a healthy rhythm. Do not care.

phases.name: Phase 11: Crimson
phases.effects: The blood has stopped being red fluid and started being red light: a saturated crimson field with veins running through it and a permanent spray off both edges. Base 52,000 DMG and 220,000 HP.
phases.notification: It has stopped looking wet. It has started looking hungry.

phases.name: Phase 12: Fester
phases.effects: The rot reaches the core and the blade stops being weak — this is where the fragile half of the curve ends. Unlocks Exsanguinate [X] — every enemy within 3x your swing range bleeds for 5s, taking 45% damage per second while you heal for 10% of the bleed. Base 510,000 DMG and 1,020,000 HP.
phases.notification: ...It rotted. ...It is still spreading. Let it.

phases.name: Phase 13: Carnage
phases.effects: The sword stops being a weapon and starts being a site: blood everywhere, at every scale, all of it coming out of the blade and none of it coming back. Base 620,000 DMG and 1,200,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not swinging. It is spilling.

phases.name: Phase 14: Bloodlust
phases.effects: The blade drags a red wake that reaches for survivors on its own, and the more it takes the faster the wielder moves. Base 850,000 DMG and 4,200,000 HP.
phases.notification: It wants more than you are giving it. So give it more.

phases.name: Phase 15: Crimson Tide
phases.effects: A tide of blood follows the blade across the ground and does not recede, rising around everything that is still standing. Base 2,200,000 DMG and 9,000,000 HP.
phases.notification: It is not aimed at anything any more. It is just rising.

phases.name: Phase 16: Heartstopper
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: HEARTSTOPPER. Sanguine has stopped taking blood and started deciding whose it is — every beat of the blade stops something else instead. Base 5,200,000 DMG, 15,000,000 HP and 168 SPD. Stop.
phases.notification: Everything that ever beat had to get it from somewhere. This is where it comes back to.
